full.command: conda run -n appworld_env python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp <isolated-system-temp>

preliminary_environment_failures: One preliminary local full run had a Windows temporary-directory os.replace ACL failure after 1039 passes; the exact failed legacy test passed in an isolated system temp directory and the final full suite passed.

The first Lambda source candidate omitted docs/datasets because a broad datasets/ ignore rule hid local files; Lambda release tests detected it, tracking was repaired, and all final-source suites passed.
